title: Null Controllability of a Stochastic Parabolic Equation with a Space-Dependent Analytic Noise Coefficient
summary: We consider a stochastic parabolic equation on the $n$-dimensional flat torus $\mathbb{T}^n=(\mathbb{R}/(2π\mathbb Z))^n$, $n\in\mathbb N$, whose only control acts in the drift. The multiplicative-noise coefficient is adapted and may depend jointly on the sample point, time, and space. Its spatial profiles are assumed to be real analytic with a uniform positive radius of analyticity, while the corresponding analytic norm is only required to be square integrable in time, uniformly along sample paths. We prove a state-only observability inequality with an $L^1$-in-time mean-square observation…
